title: Align-VAE: Aligning Attention and Geometry in VecSet VAEs for 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Set-based variational autoencoders (VecSet VAEs) represent 3D shapes as compact sets of latent tokens. Although each token originates from a query at a sampled surface location, whether these latents truly align with geometry remains unclear. We investigate this alignment and identify four issues: (i) attention-sink-like tokens that attract queries from across the shape; (ii) spatially periodic repetitions in decoder attention responses; (iii) mismatched normal information in encoder and decoder query features; and (iv) missing supervision of the intrinsic relation between signed distance fields and surface normals. To address these issues, we introduce Align-VAE with four corresponding modifications: (i) a shared bank of learnable decoder tokens provides a workspace for global computation; (ii) distance-biased cross-attention guides retrieval toward nearby predicted spatial anchors; (iii) normal-free encoder queries align the two stages' access to normal information while retaining normals in the encoder keys and values; and (iv) a screened Poisson-inspired regularizer supervises surface values and normal-direction derivatives. These changes align latent retrieval and field prediction with geometry without enlarging the per-shape code. On the ABO dataset, Align-VAE reduces Chamfer distance by 26.6% compared to the standard VecSet VAE.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2610.14734v1 的 23 页全文与关键图表核验。实验数字与比较均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。代码状态：not-found。
analysis.ideaZh: Align-VAE 将decoder global workspace、预测anchor的distance bias、normal-free encoder queries和field supervision组合，保持每shape code大小。作者报告8192token ABO CD降低26.6%；值得深读attention与几何对齐诊断，但normal supervision在4096消融中反而增大gradient角误差，生成能力仍未评估。
analysis.motivationZh: VecSet token虽由表面位置初始化，其encoder/decoder attention会跨空间取证、过度重复，并依赖decoder不可获得的query normals。
analysis.methodZh: encoder query去掉normal而support keys/values保留normal；decoder prepend共享learnable bank承担global context，shape tokens由FPS target回归anchor，并在crossattention施加stop-gradient distance prior。表面零值和法线方向finite difference loss约束TSDF；共享bank不占per-shape latent storage但增加decoder计算。
analysis.experimentsZh: 4096/8192 latent budgets，Objaverse/ABO/in-the-wild与DoraBench；VecSet/LATTICE reproductions和released Dora/HY3D；CD、F1、sharp-feature与attention profiling；固定storage和单独成本表。 以下结果为作者报告：作者报告ABO8192tokens CD3.927→2.884×10^-3，F1@.00134.53→41.20%。（Table1 p.8）；作者报告4096token每shape512KiB保持，latent refinement53.99→56.32ms。（Table10 p.19） 对照范围：与同code预算VecSet/LATTICE比较较有解释力，released AE训练数据/latent conventions不完全等同；无生成模型或editing downstream验证。 消融与诊断：累计加bank/distance/query-normal/normal-supervision，bank先贡献主要CD下降；distance与normal-free具有attention诊断收益，部分successive reconstruction置信区间含零。
analysis.insightZh: 新意是系统诊断后把global workspace与local retrieval职责拆开，并修正query normal的不一致；不是单纯加token或loss提分。
analysis.evidenceZh: bank共享且不增大存储code，distance bias基于预测anchor而非解码时使用原FPS点。（Sec.5.1–5.3 pp.5–6; Fig.4 p.5）；normal-free只去query normal，support仍携带观测orientation。（Sec.5.2 p.6）；reconstruction与normal方向并非单调共同改进。（Tables3–4 p.9）
analysis.whyRelevantZh: compact native3D shape representation直接服务3D资产方法，局部geometry与latent alignment有明确迁移价值。
analysis.caveatZh: global bank增加decode计算；surface accuracy和field orientation需进一步平衡（p.10）。；仅reconstruction并不能证明latent diffusion易学或生成更好。；normal supervision在某配置反而恶化orientation，不能笼统称所有几何对齐指标改善。；cumulative消融受交互影响，独立因果贡献有限。
